title: Innovators for Animals: Thuy Hien Nguyen
summary: Learn from our Global Diagnostics, Group Director, Core Platform Lead how we’re transforming the landscape of animal health diagnostics with innovative tools.
body_markdown:
Thuy Hien Nguyen’s passion for diagnostics shines through as she discusses the evolution of the field from “impossibilities” to practical solutions. With a decade of experience along with her work on the Virtual Lab and innovative AI-powered tools like the Vetscan Imagyst, Thuy ensures that Zoetis remains at the forefront of diagnostic solutions for animal health, advancing veterinary medicine.
